title: Adaptively Robust Resettable Streaming
authors: Edith Cohen, Elena Gribelyuk, Jelani Nelson, Uri Stemmer
abstract:
We study algorithms in the resettable streaming model, where the value of each key can either be increased or reset to zero. The model is suitable for applications such as active resource monitoring with support for deletions and machine unlearning. We show that all existing sketches for this model are vulnerable to adaptive adversarial attacks that apply even when the sketch size is polynomial in the length of the stream.
  To overcome these vulnerabilities, we present the first adaptively robust sketches for resettable streams that maintain polylogarithmic space complexity in the stream length. Our framework supports (sub) linear statistics including $L_p$ moments for $p\in[0,1]$ (in particular, Cardinality and Sum) and Bernstein statistics. We bypass strong impossibility results known for linear and composable sketches by designing dedicated streaming sketches robustified via Differential Privacy. Unlike standard robustification techniques, which provide limited benefits in this setting and still require polynomial space in the stream length, we leverage the Binary Tree Mechanism for continual observation to protect the sketch's internal randomness. This enables accurate prefix-max error guarantees with polylogarithmic space.
summary:
- 核心创新点：首次在重置流模型中给出自适应鲁棒的草图，通过差分隐私式鲁棒化结合二叉树机制保护内部随机性，在对数空间内实现前缀最大误差的高鲁棒性。

- 主要方法：提出 adaptively robust sketches for resettable streams；利用差分隐私启发的鲁棒化策略，结合 Binary Tree Mechanism 以实现对持续观测的保护，从而绕过对线性/可组合草图的强不可行性结果；支持包括 p∈[0,1] 的 L_p 统计（尤其是基数 Cardinality、Sum）以及 Bernstein 统计在内的(子)线性统计。

- 结论/性能：在流长度的多项式对数空间内实现自适应鲁棒性，获得前缀最大误差的准确性保障，覆盖 Cardinality、Sum、 Bernstein 等统计，首次在重置流中达到 polylog 尺度的鲁棒草图。
